Faq.title: वारंवार विचारले जाणारे प्रश्न.
Faq.a0: MenuList ही एक सिस्टम आहे जी तुमचा अधिकृत मेन्यू एकाच ठिकाणाहून व्यवस्थापित करते. अपडेट केल्यावर प्रत्येक सर्फेसवर बरोबर राहतो.
Faq.a1: अजिबात नाही. व्यवसाय मालकांसाठी बनवलेले. बहुतेक 10 मिनिटांत लाइव्ह होतात.
Faq.a2: एकदा अपडेट करा — प्रत्येक सर्फेस लगेच अपडेट होतो.
Faq.q3: माझी स्वतःची ब्रँडिंग वापरता येते का?
Faq.a3: हो. तुमचा मेन्यू तुमचे रंग, फॉन्ट आणि लोगो मिळवतो.
Faq.a4: मेन्यू किंवा किंमत यादी असलेल्या कोणत्याही व्यवसायासाठी — रेस्टॉरंट, सलून, स्पा आणि बरेच काही.
Faq.a5: हो. Google Cloud / Firebase इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चरवर TLS एन्क्रिप्शनसह चालतो.
Faq.a6: हो. एकाच अकाउंटमधून प्रत्येक लोकेशनसाठी वेगळे मेन्यू व्यवस्थापित करता येतात.
Faq.a7: सुरू करण्यासाठी मोफत प्लॅन आहे, अतिरिक्त फीचर्ससाठी पेड प्लॅन्स आहेत.

Features.heroSubtitle: MenuList is not a feature list. It is a calm system that handles everything your menu touches — so you can focus on your business.
Features.group0Heading: From your menu to publish-ready — in minutes.
Features.group0Subheading: No manual typing. No photographers. No copywriters.
Features.group0F0Desc: Take a photo or upload a PDF of your existing menu. Every item, price, and category is extracted and structured automatically.
Features.group0F1Desc: Every menu item gets a professional image generated from your menu data. No photoshoot or stock library needed.
Features.group0F2Desc: Appetising, professional descriptions for every item — generated in one click, in your language.
Features.group0F3Desc: Add any language instantly. Item names, descriptions, and categories — all translated. Customers choose their preferred language when they scan.
Features.group1Subheading: Update your menu once — it reaches customers everywhere they look.
Features.group1F0Desc: Customers scan and see your current menu on any phone, any browser. Always up to date.
Features.group1F1Desc: Your menu, hours, Google rating, photos, and contact on one official page. Replaces your website and Google listing as the default link you share everywhere.
Features.group1F2Desc: Your full menu on your shop TV. Categories, items, prices — updated automatically.
Features.group1F3Desc: One link for WhatsApp, Instagram, packaging, or your website. Stays accurate automatically.
Features.group1F4Desc: A clean, print-ready PDF from your menu data. Always reflects your current menu.
Features.group1F5Desc: Mark what you offer — WiFi, outdoor seating, parking, dietary options, payment methods. These appear on your business page and help search engines understand your business.
Features.group2Subheading: Match your digital menu to your brand without a designer.
Features.group2F0Desc: Set your accent color, upload your logo, and choose a layout. Preview on mobile, tablet, and desktop before publishing.
Features.group2F1Desc: When you publish, your table tent, counter sticker, entrance poster, delivery bag sticker, takeaway card, WhatsApp link, and Instagram story are ready to download immediately.
Features.group2F2Desc: Download branded table tents, counter stickers, entrance posters, delivery bag stickers, and takeaway cards — all with your QR code. Ready to print for your physical location.
Features.group3Heading: Your menu works after you publish.
Features.group3Subheading: Built-in systems that run automatically — for customers and staff.
Features.group3F0Desc: Most Popular, Quick Pick, and Best Value sections appear on your menu automatically — updated nightly based on real customer behaviour. Zero setup.
Features.group3F1Desc: Staff can look up current prices, availability, and item details on any phone. New staff answer customer questions on day one.
Features.group3F2Desc: Item views, busy hours, and menu performance — captured automatically and accessible in your dashboard.
Features.group3F3Desc: Simple signals show what's missing — descriptions, images, prices. Each signal connects to the tool that fixes it. Your menu improves every time you open MenuList.
Features.group4Heading: Handle real-world changes without extra work.
Features.group4Subheading: Built for the real situations your business faces.
Features.group4F0Desc: Activate a festival or event menu with a scheduled automatic switch-back. You set it once — it reverts itself.
Features.group4F1Desc: Closed today? Opening late? Add a real-time banner that disappears automatically when it's no longer needed.
Features.group4F2Desc: Run every outlet from one master menu. Update once and all stores reflect the change — with local override capability.
Features.group4F3Desc: A simple status checklist shows where your menu is visible — Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, QR, screens — and which surfaces still need setup.
Features.group4F4Desc: Pre-written messages for "Send menu", "Where are you?", and "Are you open?" — with your link, address, and hours included. One tap to copy and send.
Features.group4F5Desc: Bulk operations for pricing, availability, categories, and status. Select multiple items and apply changes in one action — with full preview before applying.
Features.group5Subheading: Built-in systems that prevent mistakes from reaching your customers.
Features.group5F0Desc: One price change reaches every surface instantly — QR menu, digital screens, PDF, and staff view all match.
Features.group5F1Desc: Every save is checked automatically. Missing prices, empty categories, or broken items are flagged before publishing.
Features.group5F2Desc: Location, operational status, offering type, and freshness date appear on your menu page. Customers see evidence that your menu is real and current.
Features.ctaTitle: Your menu should have one official version.
Features.ctaSubtitle: Takes minutes. No design or technical setup.

HowItWorks.heroSubtitle: Upload your menu once. We structure it, prepare it, and publish it across every surface your customers use — without you doing the work.
HowItWorks.flowTitle: One input. One system. Every surface.
HowItWorks.flowSubtitle: No duplicate uploads. No parallel updates.
HowItWorks.step1Subtitle: Take a photo of your paper menu. Upload a PDF. Or type items directly. In minutes, everything is structured and ready. No data entry. No formatting.
HowItWorks.step1P0: Works with any format — photo, PDF, or typed input
HowItWorks.step1P1: Items, prices, and categories read for you — no manual entry
HowItWorks.step1P2: Handles multiple pages and handwritten menus
HowItWorks.step1P3: Review everything before publishing — nothing goes live without your sign-off
HowItWorks.step2Subtitle: Every item gets a professional image, an appetizing description, and translations in your chosen languages — all generated from your menu data.
HowItWorks.step2Subtitle2: No photoshoot. No copywriter. No translator. One click and your entire menu is content-complete.
HowItWorks.step3Subtitle: When you publish, your menu goes live across every surface simultaneously. No partial updates. No surface left behind.
HowItWorks.step3P0: QR menu, official page, screens, and shareable link — live simultaneously
HowItWorks.step3P1: No partial updates. Every surface updates at the same moment
HowItWorks.step3P2: Your launch kit downloads instantly — table tent, entrance poster, counter sticker, delivery bag sticker, takeaway card, Instagram story
HowItWorks.surfacesTitle: Your menu, everywhere your customers look.
HowItWorks.surfacesSubtitle: All surfaces read from the same official version. Once published, your menu appears wherever customers look.
HowItWorks.step4Subtitle: Change a price — every surface shows it in seconds. Mark an item sold out — it disappears everywhere. Update your hours — every surface reflects it. You update once. The system handles the rest.

MultiLocation.heroSubtitle: Manage pricing, availability, and presentation across all your outlets from one place. Updates reach every location instantly — without manual coordination between branches.
MultiLocation.flowTitle: One master. Every outlet inherits it.
MultiLocation.flowSubtitle: Changes at HQ reach every location in seconds.
MultiLocation.problemTitle: Managing five menus is five times the work.
MultiLocation.problemBody: Prices drift between locations. Items disappear from one outlet but not others. Names change without HQ knowing. Instead of running your business, you're chasing consistency across five different menus.
MultiLocation.problemConclusion: Inconsistency compounds as you grow. MenuList stops it before it starts.
MultiLocation.step1Title: One master menu. Every outlet inherits it.
MultiLocation.step1Subtitle: Build your core menu once at HQ. When you update the master, every linked outlet reflects the change instantly. That work you used to do five times? Done once.
MultiLocation.step1P0: Build your core menu once at HQ — all outlets inherit it instantly

MultiLocation.ctaTitle: Run every location from a single master.

About.title: About
About.body1: MenuList is a system that manages official menus and public business information from a single source of truth. It keeps menu content accurate and aligned across customer-facing surfaces including QR, web, screens, and print.
About.body2: We built MenuList because every business deserves one place where their menu is always correct. Not a tool to manage. Not a platform to learn. A system that handles your menu so you don't have to.
About.whoBody: MenuList is built in India for businesses that care about how they present themselves to customers.
About.footerText: Built in India. Used by growing businesses.
